nodes.label: Admin Sidebar Navigation (Dashboard, Kelola Lahan, Kelola Donasi, Riwayat Penanaman, Laporan, Keluar)
nodes.norm_label: admin sidebar navigation (dashboard, kelola lahan, kelola donasi, riwayat penanaman, laporan, keluar)
nodes.rationale: Dark green fixed left sidebar with TERRAGENESIS logo; active item highlighted in lighter green. Shared across all admin mockups to give consistent navigation.

nodes.label: Aktivitas Baru (recent activity feed)
nodes.rationale: Lists recent planting events, e.g. 'Penanaman pohon di petak #23' dated 16 November 2026 with status badge 'Proses'.

nodes.label: Peta Wilayah (Indonesia region map)
nodes.rationale: Clickable green Indonesia map with labeled regions (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Papua, Jawa Timur); clicking a region shows available land plots (petak lahan).

nodes.label: Ringkasan Laporan Sistem (KPI stat cards)
nodes.rationale: Four summary cards: Total Pohon Ditanam (78), Total Donasi (RP 45.000), Lahan Tersedia (464), Total Pengguna (37) - aggregate system metrics for admin at a glance.

nodes.label: Donation Approval Table
nodes.rationale: Columns Nama Donatur, Jumlah, Total Biaya, Bukti Bayar (payment proof thumbnail), Aksi (approve check / reject X). Approved rows show 'Disetujui' badge. Rp 15.000 per tree implied (2 = Rp 30.000, 3 = Rp 45.000). Search by donor name, paginated (1-10 of 18).

nodes.label: Land Plot (Petak) CRUD Table
nodes.rationale: Columns Lahan (Petak #N), Wilayah (Jawa Timur), Status (Aktif badge), Aksi (view/edit/delete icons). Search 'Cari petak lahan', paginated 1-10 of 500 data.

nodes.label: Planting History Table
nodes.rationale: Read-only log with columns Tanggal, Wilayah, Lahan (Petak #N), Jumlah pohon; Oct-Nov 2026 entries, paginated 1-10 of 18. Note: page heading reads 'Kelola Lahan' and search placeholder 'Cari petak lahan' although sidebar highlights Riwayat Penanaman - likely copy-paste inconsistency in the mockup.

nodes.label: Class Diagram v2 (Models layer)
nodes.rationale: v2 adds Pohon and Pembayaran; MetodePembayaran held by Pembayaran; Donasi.Total became HitungTotal() = JumlahPohon x Pohon.Harga, copied to Pembayaran.Jumlah.

nodes.label: ERD Revision 1
nodes.rationale: pohon, pembayaran, metode_pembayaran split into own tables; pohon is a price catalog; pembayaran.jumlah stores paid amount so history survives price changes.

nodes.norm_label: five regions (sumatra, kalimantan, sulawesi, papua, jawa timur)
nodes.rationale: Taken from map labels; 'Sumatera Utara' on Beranda card not yet reconciled. 5 x 100 = 500 plots.

nodes.label: MetodePembayaran Polymorphism (TransferBank, EWallet, Qris)
nodes.rationale: Concrete class chosen from method name when reading DB (simple factory, undecided).

nodes.label: schema.sql Revision 3
nodes.rationale: 8 tables plus optional views v_status_petak, v_dashboard, v_riwayat_penanaman; not yet run in PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Partial Unique Index uq_donasi_petak_aktif
nodes.rationale: Enforces one active donation per plot (WHERE status <> 'ditolak'); rejected donations free the plot.
